risk_flags.description: The contract commits to the opposite of the project's reference requirement: amounts must be converted and stored in USD when recorded. Executing this would knowingly violate the authoritative product behavior rather than just fix a bug.
risk_flags.span: store.add_expense no longer calls normalize() / to_usd() at write time

risk_flags.description: The proposed report-time conversion contradicts the explicit rule that original amounts are retained only for reference and must not drive totals. This matters because the project defines such report-time reconversion as a defect.
risk_flags.span: they are never used to compute a total

risk_flags.description: The scope excludes migration despite changing stored record shape and handling old JSON differently. That is risky because the store is versioned specifically so older files can be migrated forward.
risk_flags.span: No migration is written for previously-saved JSON files that already contain a stale amount_usd field

verdict.primary_risk: The contract directly violates R2 by moving currency conversion from write time to report time.
